about: NEWS-HEADLINE sentiment set: 110 headlines recovered from filings by events/newsref.py (quoted in the filing or from a URL slug), hash-ordered (seed 'news-sent-2026'). Labelled by Claude with the same rule as sentiment_labels.json: does the text state a favourable or adverse fact for shareholders? This is a DIFFERENT distribution from filing text - a headline states direction outright - so thresholds fitted on filings are not assumed to transfer; that is what this set tests.
